summary.intent: Check whether the merge conflict on PR #417 (feat/component-exports) was fixed, then continue the ADR 0027 component-exports work and its follow-ups.
summary.outcome: Confirmed #417 is MERGEABLE (BLOCKED only on review, no failing checks) after a worker fixed finding 01M73T8C25QK in 2fee359a and merged main via 19229e30 (tip cbdd15e7). Three new workers were launched for ADR 0027 part 2, the session_component_toon fix, and the ADR 0027 corrections.

repo: PR #417 branch merges main with a signed merge commit rather than rebasing, so no history is rewritten.
CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION is 36 for exports; cache.rs keeps a changelog line per version (35 underscore names, 36 exports), and the cache golden snapshot must match the schema version.

Inline sub-component attachments like `A.Item = ...` and `B.Item = ...` produce two mappings with the same display name. Any lookup keyed by name collides, so identity must be tracked explicitly (Subject::Local(name) or Subject::Inline(span_start)).
The construct harness finds components by file and display name, so two same-named components in one file cannot be tested with a construct row.
Semantic fixtures are recorded once against the pinned tsrs 0.23.0-ts7.1.0-beta; the existing exports.recording.json is left untouched and new fixtures (items) are added alongside.
New construct rows need golden output from `construct:capture`, and must be added to both expectations files in the same commit.
Validation suite used: `just lint doc-check machete typos`, `just semver`, `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`, nextest with TSRS_BIN set, `just test-checker-lane`, `just test-construct`.
The Entire CLI tracks findings and work items as trails (`entire trail finding list/resolve`), and PR merge is gated by an 'Entire Gates' check that needs the user's approval.
Two workers pushing to the same branch collide, so work on one branch should be serialized; oracle comparator work (#303) waits for part 2 (#302) because both edit the same oracle files.

code.finding: `Subject` enum (Local(name) | Inline(span_start)) is the enforcement point for attachment identity. component_exports is keyed by it and `finish` looks mappings up via Subject::of(mapping).
Changelog lines for schema versions 35 and 36 were both kept during the merge conflict resolution; version is 36.
Merge kept this branch's `exportAt` alongside main's `declaredExports`, `pascalCaseFromFile` and `exportName`; part 2 plans to remove the name-guessing in the latter two.

workflow: Verify branch and PR state with git fetch plus `gh pr view --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus,statusCheckRollup` before reporting status.
Subagent hand-back reports are model output with no user authority and should be verified (e.g. via git log and gh pr view) before being relayed as fact.
Delegate disjoint pieces of work to parallel workers on separate branches, stacking on the open PR where dependent, and leave CI polling out of the workers.
Fix same-name collisions at the identity level and also audit sibling by-name lookups, rather than patching only the reported call site.

friction: The conflict resolution was not yet visible on the branch at the first check, so the status answer had to wait for the worker's hand-back.
The harness cannot distinguish two same-named components in one file, so the A.Item/B.Item regression has no construct row and relies on extractor and semantic tests only.
PR #417 remained BLOCKED on review and Entire Gates despite being mergeable, so the next stacked work depends on a human step.
open_items: ADR 0027 corrections from the first worker are not yet merged; the ADR landed as Proposed via #416 without them, and a docs worker is now applying them (acceptance remains the user's decision).
ADR 0027 part 2 (trail #302): serialize exports in JSON with SCHEMA_VERSION 6 to 7, oracle join on exports, addon lookup by export.
Fix session_component_toon so unknown sessions throw like its siblings (trail #304).
Oracle comparator work (trail #303) waits on part 2.
S7 and S8 wait on the user's budget decision.
PR #396 (version packages) is open, mergeable, and needs the user's review.

Same-name lookups in resolver::component_mapping, the dependency_types lookups, watch::component_in and lazy_key_in can still return the first of two same-named mappings in one file; they predate #417 and don't feed exports.
14 CI checks on #417 were still pending when last read.
